description: npm changelog between two versions: full release notes of every version in the range (newest first), with dates, bump type, deprecations, extracted breaking changes and package.json changes. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

from.description: Version you are on now: exact ('18.3.1') or a major/minor prefix ('18', '4.21') meaning the newest release of that series

maxVersions.description: Newest N versions to return notes for (default 30)

prereleases.description: Include alpha/beta/rc versions in the range

to.description: Target version: exact, or a major/minor prefix ('19', '2.0') meaning the first release of that series (19.0.0). Default: latest stable

name: npm_changelog
title: npm changelog
